newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends stable in slow trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends stable in slow trade.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar closed almost unchanged against its U.S. counterpart on Saturday in slow trade amid a lack of market-moving factors.
The local unit ended at T$27.924 against Friday's 27.926 close, off an intraday high of 27.923. Turnover through dealers was a thin T$77 million.
"Saturday is usually a slow day, and there are no market-moving factors today too," said a foreign bank dealer.
Dealers said they did not see inflows or outflows of foreign equity funds, despite the stock index closing on Saturday at a fresh seven-year-high on heavy turnover.
